title: Planned file writes
responsibility: Creates parent directories, writes planned text files with overwrite protection, and formats the resulting statuses.

inputs.name: writePlannedFiles.root
inputs.description: Root directory against which each planned path is joined.

inputs.name: writePlannedFiles.files
inputs.description: Ordered relative paths and text contents to write; parent directories must already exist.

inputs.name: writePlannedFiles.options
inputs.description: Optional force flag, default false, permitting replacement of differing existing contents.

inputs.name: ensureParents.root
inputs.description: Root directory under which parent folders should be created.

inputs.name: ensureParents.files
inputs.description: Planned files whose parent directories are created recursively.

inputs.name: renderFileList.files
inputs.description: File write results with created, skipped or overwritten status.

outputs.name: writePlannedFiles
outputs.description: Resolves ordered file results. Identical files are skipped, absent files created and differing files overwritten only with force; earlier writes remain if a later file fails.

outputs.name: ensureParents
outputs.description: Resolves after ensuring each distinct parent directory exists; writes no file contents.

outputs.name: renderFileList
outputs.description: One indented create, overwrite or skip line per file, joined by newlines.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when an existing file differs and force was not requested.
